test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A 200 m long train crosses a man standing on a platform in 10 seconds, and another train of the same length coming from the opposite direction in 8 seconds. Find the speed of the second train.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Speed of first train (S₁) = 200 / 10 = 20 m/s Relative speed (S₁ + S₂) = Total distance / Time = (200 + 200) / 8 = 50 m/s Speed of second train (S₂) = 50 − 20 = 30 m/s S₂ in km/h = 30 × 18/5 = 108 km/h **∴ The correct answer is 108 km/h.**
